integrity: Proof and executable exact finite comparison included. All computations are finite corroboration, not a proof of unrestricted quantifiers. No independent certification is claimed.
limitations: For once-subdivided labelled complete graphs and minimum-cardinality paired dominating vertex sets only. The minimum cardinality was known in 2016; the claimed new result is the structural classification and matching-multiplicity distribution. Independent historical priority and independent mathematical verification are not established.
title: Paired-domination minima in subdivided cliques: a rooted-pseudoforest enumeration
